rationale: The problem requires same-field retrieval to ground solutions in engineered living materials, bioconjugation, synthetic biology, hydrogels, and photodegradable matrices. Cross-domain retrieval is also needed because key bottlenecks—closed-loop control, orthogonal multi-input regulation, spatiotemporal patterning, containment-release balance, and multiscale design rules—suggest transfer of mechanisms from developmental biology, control theory, soft matter, biofilm ecology, photopharmacology, or microfabrication.
